description: Defines interfaces and classes for managing socket connection pools, including layered pools, socket parameters, and socket request handling within the Chromium networking code.

classes.name: HigherLayeredPool
classes.description: Interface for higher layer socket pools to communicate with lower layer pools, with method to close idle connections.

classes.name: LowerLayeredPool
classes.description: Interface for layered socket pools to check if stalled and to add/remove higher layer pools.

classes.name: ClientSocketPool
classes.description: Abstract class managing socket connection pooling, including socket requests, priorities, and idle socket management.

classes.name: ClientSocketPool::GroupId
classes.description: Represents a group identifier for socket requests, based on destination, privacy, network key, and DNS policy.

classes.name: ClientSocketPool::SocketParams
classes.description: Ref-counted class holding parameters for socket creation, including SSL configurations for origin and proxy.

methods.name: RequestSocket
methods.description: Requests a connected socket for a specified group, with callback for completion or errors.

methods.name: RequestSockets
methods.description: Requests multiple sockets for a group to ensure availability.

methods.name: SetPriority
methods.description: Changes the priority of an ongoing socket request.

methods.name: ReleaseSocket
methods.description: Releases a socket back to the pool, adding it to idle sockets if still connected.

methods.name: FlushWithError
methods.description: Fails all pending requests and clears pool state with an error.

methods.name: CloseIdleSocketsInGroup
methods.description: Closes idle sockets within a specific group.

methods.name: IdleSocketCount
methods.description: Returns total number of idle sockets.

methods.name: IdleSocketCountInGroup
methods.description: Returns number of idle sockets in a specific group.

methods.name: GetLoadState
methods.description: Returns load state of a socket handle.

methods.name: GetInfoAsValue
methods.description: Provides current pool state as a value for diagnostics.

methods.name: HasActiveSocket
methods.description: Checks if a socket exists for a group.
